newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Iran aims for international bunker oil market.
newsitem.headline: Iran aims for international bunker oil market.

text.p: Iran has plans to offer an oil bunkering service to foreign shippers at Kharg Island and other Iranian ports, Mohammad Souri, chairman of the state-owned National Iranian Tanker Company (NITC) said Wednesday.
"In the near future we are going to have facilities in ports to provide bunkers," Souri said on the sidelines of an oil and gas conference in Abu Dhabi.
Iran currently has no bunkering services for foreign ships which use bunker facilities in the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia and Kuwait to fuel their vessels when in the Gulf.
NITC, in a joint venture with an Iranian fuel distributor for the bunkering project, would aim to attract shippers using ports in Kuwait, Iraq, Iran and Saudi Arabia, Souri said.
Storage tanks would be allocated at Kharg to enable bunkering operations and a bunkering ship would also used.
Kharg Island would offer bunker fuel from Iran's leading Abadan oil refinery while southern ports would use bunkers from the new Bandar Abbas refinery which is due onstream this year.
